content: 1. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases vinblastine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 2. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases vincristine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 3. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases vincristine liposomal levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 4. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases vinorelbine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 5. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases voclosporin levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. Close monitoring is recommended. 6. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases zaleplon levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 7. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases ziprasidone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 8. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases zolpidem levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 9. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases zonisamide levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 10. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases acalabrutinib levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is advised. If co-administered with moderate CYP3A inhibitors, reduce the acalabrutinib dose to 100 mg once daily. 11. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases alfentanil levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 12. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases alfuzosin levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 13. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases almotriptan levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 14. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases alosetron levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 15. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases alprazolam levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 16. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases amiodarone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is serious, and alternative therapies should be considered. Co-administration is contraindicated. 17. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases amitriptyline levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 18. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases amlodipine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 19. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases aprepitant levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 20. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases aripiprazole levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 21. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases armodafinil levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 22. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases artemether/lumefantrine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 23. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases atazanavir levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 24. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases atogepant levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 25. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases atorvastatin levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 26. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases avanafil levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is serious, and alternative therapies should be considered. The maximum recommended dose of avanafil is 50 mg, not to exceed once every 24 hours when co-administered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. 27. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases avapritinib levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration should be avoided or alternative therapies used. If unavoidable, reduce the starting dose of avapritinib. 28. Quinupristin/dalfopristin decreases balsalazide levels or effects by altering intestinal flora. This applies only to oral forms of both agents. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 29. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases bazedoxifene/conjugated estrogens levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. It may also decrease their levels by altering intestinal flora. This applies only to oral forms of the hormone. There is a low risk of contraceptive failure. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 30. Quinupristin/dalfopristin decreases the effects of the BCG vaccine live due to pharmacodynamic antagonism. Co-administration is contraindicated. Wait until antibiotic treatment is complete before administering live bacterial vaccines. 31. Quinupristin/dalfopristin decreases biotin levels or effects by altering intestinal flora. This applies only to oral forms of both agents. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 32. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases bortezomib levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 33. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases bosentan levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 34. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases budesonide levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 35. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases buprenorphine subdermal implant levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is advised. Implant removal may be necessary if overmedication occurs. 36. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases buprenorphine long-acting injection levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is advised. Transition to a formulation that allows dose adjustments if toxicity occurs. 37. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases buspirone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 38. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases cannabidiol levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is advised. Consider reducing the cannabidiol dose. 39. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases capivasertib levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is advised. Reduce the capivasertib dose if co-administered with moderate CYP3A inhibitors. 40. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases carbamazepine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 41. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases cevimeline levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 42. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases cilostazol levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 43. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases cinacalcet levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 44. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases clarithromycin levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated. 45. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases clomipramine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 46. Quinupristin/dalfopristin decreases clopidogrel levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, reducing clopidogrel bioactivation. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 47. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases clozapine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 48. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases conivaptan levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 49. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases conjugated estrogens levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. It may also decrease their levels by altering intestinal flora. This applies only to oral forms of the hormone. There is a low risk of contraceptive failure. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 50. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases cortisone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 51. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases cyclosporine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 52. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases dapsone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 53. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases daridorexant levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is advised. The daridorexant dose should not exceed 25 mg per night when co-administered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. 54. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases darifenacin levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 55. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases darunavir levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 56. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases dasatinib levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 57. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases deflazacort levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification or close monitoring is advised. Reduce the deflazacort dose to one-third of the recommended dose if co-administered with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 58. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases dexamethasone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 59. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases diazepam levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 60. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases diazepam buccal levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors may decrease the rate of diazepam elimination, increasing adverse reactions. 61. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases diazepam intranasal levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors may decrease the rate of diazepam elimination, increasing adverse reactions. 62. Quinupristin/dalfopristin decreases dienogest/estradiol valerate levels or effects by altering intestinal flora. This applies only to oral forms of the hormone. There is a low risk of contraceptive failure. An alternate or additional form of birth control may be advisable during concomitant use. 63. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases digoxin levels or effects by altering intestinal flora. This applies only to oral forms of both agents. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 64. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases dihydroergotamine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is serious, and alternative therapies should be considered. This list provides a detailed explanation of the interactions between quinupristin/dalfopristin and various drugs, emphasizing the need for monitoring, dose adjustments, or alternative therapies in specific cases.
